soundness_flags.label: Theorem 3 / definitions of N and B
soundness_flags.one_line: With D=diag(d) and R_{cell,j}=w_j B_{cell,j}/d_{cell}, the displayed N is the D-orthogonal projector onto ker(R^T D)=ker(B^T diag(w)), not onto the claimed ker(B^T); thus the load-bearing projector statement is false except under an unstated exceptional restriction on w.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 13-16, Theorems 2 and 4; pp. 59-62, Supplement S8.2
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives the binary observed tangent space and orthocomplement, projects the valid influence function to obtain the EIF, and constructs an equal-width continuous-outcome partition basis dense in the binary orthocomplement; it states that sufficiently fine discretization asymptotically recovers the efficiency bound.
Appendix A.8 defines K-class inverse-feature representations q_a^X, their products, and a valid observed-data influence function, with a separate categorical label-alignment condition.
The paper compares bridge and array-decomposition assumptions; it says array-decomposition semiparametric theory for hidden-treatment proxies remains relatively nascent.

The paper identifies a broad class of continuous nonclassical errors-in-variables models through integral-operator eigendecomposition and proposes sieve estimation; the inspected source does not state the proposal's DQM score-lifting theorem.

The paper applies Hu-Schennach-style triple-proxy recovery to nonparametric causal identification using three conditionally independent proxies and identifies objects up to latent transformations/reorderings.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the posterior-based first elimination with a derivation from the actual measurement-score cell span: either use B in the D-projection or prove an exact observed reparameterization whose weighted null space is the intended one, then recompute every downstream Gram, residual-energy, and covariance identity.

After correcting the operator, give a small symbolic K=3 calculation with nonconstant posterior weights that verifies N^T D=N's weighted self-adjoint relation and explicitly checks the claimed null space before reasserting tangent or efficiency conclusions.

Keep Proposition 2 and Proposition 10 explicitly as known comparator reductions, and concentrate the revised field kernel on a valid multilevel tangent-completeness theorem plus a strictly smaller fixed-dimensional exact projection than the binary partition sequence.
